beats.label: 1 day vs 3 days
beats.text: Older adults lifted **1,** **2** or **3** days a week for 24 weeks.
beats.note: Taaffe et al., J. Am. Geriatr. Soc., 1999

beats.label: The result
beats.text: Strength rose about **37%** with once a week, **40%** with three.

beats.label: The catch
beats.text: Each session was **hard:** heavy weights, **8** **exercises,** 3 sets.

beats.label: Long term
beats.text: 30-year data links lifting to **lower** **early-death** risk, leveling off near **2** **hours** a week.
beats.note: Harvard Chan, Br. J. Sports Med., 2026

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: That trial had just **46** **people,** and the big study shows a **link,** not proof.
